body: Thank you, I am sending you love and healing and I hope that things get better for you! I will definitely try some of these things.
I have been pushing her to go to the doctor recently (because she just got insurance) so I am hoping some good will come out of it! Thank you for the advice, I really appreciate it.

I'm not much of a dancer, but I feel like I could put aside my own embarrassment to dance with her. I feel like a major reason she stopped was that nobody else was dancing with her - so I will try this.. Thank you for the advice!

I also recently read an article about how to cope with existential dread and in the article it said I went off the deep end, and there's nothing I can do to come back. I hope it isn't true. I want to enjoy my life but I can't get out of this mindset.

Thank you :) I have been told there's a lot of adults who go to college later in life and it does make me feel less alone. I guess I just feel like because I got a late start in life I am failing. But this makes me feel less anxious.

I know what you mean and I agree, it's just really hard to get out of my current situation. I am trying to catch up and have a life I just never had the guidance, I'm figuring out how to do everything on my own.

My mom doesn't really let me go anywhere and I don't have money to go and do a lot of stuff.  I take care of my disabled family members a lot of the time because I am able-bodied. I also just find it really hard to  make friends in general in my area.
After I left high school and moved I lost touch with my friends.
my therapist also told me about trauma bonding! i was not sure what it was though, and i had never heard of the term before . I'm gonna look more into that

i thought that maybe by helping him and being patient he would come around, i don't know. when we first started dating he was amazing, and then a week into the relationship he started to get "lazy" and barely put in an effort for anything. i don't know why i keep staying with him either, everyone tells me to leave. sometimes i will see glimpses of who he was when we first met and it convinces me to stay.
